name: The Cactus Cloud Ranch
description: A desert ranch where towering saguaro cacti bloom with fluffy clouds instead of flowers.
prompt: Surreal desert ranch at golden hour, towering saguaro cacti with fluffy white cloud blooms instead of flowers, wooden windmill, rain barrels, tiny cowboy boots by a fence, soft sand, purple-orange sky, highly detailed whimsical illustration, no text, no logos.
caption: Even the driest desert deserves a little cloud cover. 🌵☁️
